header.title: System & Controller Settings
header.description: Configure physical dynamics payload, spatial safety bounds, servo drive gains and service operations

kinematics.title: Kinematics & Dynamics Config (litearm.yaml)
kinematics.description: Inspect and modify kinematics DH parameters, link mass, COM offsets and inertia tensors with dual Visual Form and Native YAML Editor modes

payload.title: End-Effector Payload Calibration
payload.description: Set tool/workpiece mass and center-of-mass offset, directly affecting gravity compensation and dynamics
payload.installationDesc: Supports standard, inverted or wall-mounted mounting; base RPY defines the gravity direction, per-joint factors calibrate gravity feedforward
payload.baseRpy: Base Euler Angles (Base RPY in rad)
payload.gravityScaleDesc: Per-joint gravity compensation strength (0–10, default 1.0). Changes take effect smoothly over 2 seconds to avoid torque jumps.

safety.title: Joint Limits & Zero Offset
safety.description: Controller soft limit boundaries and motor zero calibration offset settings to prevent over-travel and collision
safety.hint: 💡 Limits are safeguarded by controller firmware and litearm.yaml dynamics rules to prevent self-collision and over-travel.
safety.cartesianDesc: TCP velocity limits, workspace boundaries and collision sensitivity settings
safety.cartesianDefaultHint: Using controller default velocity and acceleration limits
safety.collisionDefaultHint: Collision detection is in standard safety monitoring mode

gains.title: Joint PD Control Gains
gains.description: Joint servo position loop proportional gain Kp and differential damping Kd fine-tuning and transmission
gains.hint: If motion shows vibration or stiffness anomalies, adjust gains or restore default controller gains.
gains.restoreConfirmDesc: Restore controller factory default PD gains? Your custom parameters will be overwritten.
gains.faultsAndEstopDesc: Clear CAN communication/undervoltage/overtemp latch faults, release E-Stop state
gains.clearFaultsDesc: Send clearance frames to all joint servo drivers (e.g. after overcurrent/overtemp recovery)
gains.clearStopDesc: Release controller software lock from emergency stop or velocity protection

system.title: Controller System Diagnostics
system.description: Real-time controller CPU, memory, storage and board temperature

system.restartServiceDesc: Safely restart the local daemon (robot will reset to initial pose)
system.restartDialogDesc: WebSocket connection will briefly disconnect and auto-reconnect. Ensure the robot arm is stationary and safe.
system.languageDesc: Switch UI language, applies immediately and persists locally
